description: Na₄NiP₂O₇F₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. There are two shorter (2.44 Å) and two longer (2.48 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.67 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three O and two F atoms. There is one shorter (2.33 Å) and two longer (2.51 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There is one shorter (2.14 Å) and one longer (2.21 Å) Na-F bond length. Ni is bonded to four equivalent O and two equivalent F atoms to form NiO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 54°. All Ni-O bond lengths are 2.09 Å. Both Ni-F bond lengths are 2.01 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiO₄F₂ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 58°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.66 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent P atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one P atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ni atoms to form FNa₂Ni₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FNa₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent FNa₂Ni₂ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 51°. In the second F site, F is bonded to six Na atoms to form FNa₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent FNa₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent FNa₂Ni₂ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 11°.
